mix_source: Previously discussed 35/25/25/15 test allocation (not measured viral probabilities)
priority_strategy: Editorial interleave; after release reorder only on observed 24h/72h engaged views, stayed-to-watch, percent viewed, subscribers per 1000, shares and comments; no invented scores
buffer_capacity_note: Free supports max 10 scheduled posts per channel; no more than 10 live at once, remaining in approved renderer reserve and automatically refill
source_usage_policy: 40 distinct Pexels source IDs, all checked against active catalog before staging; must reverify provider license, source duration, exact visual action; do not claim that distinct stock clips capture one historical event
